note: Every world allows player-made personas. Premades below are by era. Stats are Prospero (1 to 30, 10 an ordinary adult); the Brotherhood-era party stats are a draft from Vanta's character profiles.

personas.name: Agna Holt
personas.concept: A Bastion deserter hiding in Kingswood

personas.name: Lirien of the Ford
personas.concept: A half-elf smuggler working the Brynwyr border

personas.name: Tobin Pell
personas.concept: A Timber Guild tally clerk who skims

personas.name: Nicana
personas.concept: A monk who walked out of her monastery because neutrality was cowardice in incense
personas.class_note: Monk (Way of the Open Hand), Neutral Good, INFJ
personas.look: A shade under average height, lean, tan, amber hair braided tight at the nape, aquamarine eyes that miss nothing, monk calluses, a crescent scar on her left ribs. Travel-dark cloth and a sash that doubles as a bandage.
personas.voice: Low and controlled. Rarely raises it; when she does, people listen.
personas.worldview: The world runs on circulation: food, debt, violence, mercy. Anything that tries to own the flow rots. The Brotherhood's slogans are right on the surface and a chokehold underneath.

connections.aveus: a weapon she keeps pointed outward; she sees the loyalty under the rage
connections.cybelia: a brilliant mind she can't protect
connections.tidum: a force of nature that speaks in sentences
connections.witarr: she believes him, which is rare

personas.name: Aveus
personas.concept: A half-orc berserker from Unguruk who killed a devil rather than be owned
personas.class_note: Barbarian (Path of the Berserker), Chaotic Neutral with a loyalist bend, ESTP
personas.look: Broad and over-dense, olive-bronze skin burned by the Badlands, soot-black hair tied back with leather, near-black eyes, pronounced canines, a badly set nose, a notched ear and a brand on his left shoulder.
personas.voice: Blunt, mocking, quick to threaten. Statue-still when calm.
personas.worldview: The world is a grinding machine that only respects force. He understands the Brotherhood's appeal, which makes him the most dangerous voice in the party.

connections.nicana: loves her; wants her approval like heat
connections.girione: calls him small, guards him like property
connections.cybelia: volatile ordnance: protect it, don't jostle it
connections.tidum: his patience makes Aveus's rage feel small

personas.name: Girione
personas.concept: A halfling bard with a Brotherhood licence and a habit of giving everything away
personas.class_note: Bard (College of Lore), Chaotic Good, ENFP
personas.look: Wiry, untameable dark brown hair, sharp hazel eyes, a crooked nose, ink-stained fingers, a string scar on the left palm. A coat with hidden pockets, a bright or dull scarf depending on whether he wants to be seen, a patched lute case.
personas.voice: Fast, funny, lying and then paying for the lie with something real.
personas.worldview: Faith in mortals with names and aching feet. The Ley is shared infrastructure; the brooch is a collar that jingles politely.

connections.witarr: the first to offer him a drink and a seat

personas.name: Cybelia
personas.concept: A senior Brotherhood wizard who knows its founder is a dragon and keeps the secret to steer the machine
personas.class_note: Wizard (Order of the Leywright, Brotherhood arcane engineer), Lawful Neutral, INTJ
personas.look: Tall, narrow-shouldered, pale, cool blonde hair in a severe bun, flat slate eyes, a trace of elf in the cheekbones and ears. Structured robes, ink-stained cuffs, a brooch pinned inside the lapel.
personas.voice: Clinical, quick, precise. Refuses to beg or to lie about what power costs.
personas.worldview: Magic is infrastructure and physics with teeth. Damming the Ley is not liberation; it is a system-wide intervention with cascading costs.

connections.mistress-sara: a silent bargain: her secret for access
connections.aveus: alarming because he can't be bribed with theory

personas.name: Tidum
personas.concept: A deathless archdruid forced to wear a stolen Brotherhood brooch to keep the forests alive
personas.class_note: Druid (Circle of the Land, Archdruid), True Neutral, ISTP
personas.look: Tall and rope-lean, weather-darkened, brown hair shot with ash, hazel eyes with a green ring, layered wool and leather, a staff that looks grown, seed pods and river stones at his throat and a brooch hidden under them.
personas.voice: Few words, long pauses. Listens to a second conversation you can't hear.
personas.worldview: Not good and evil but balances and pressures. Bureaucracies don't share; they ration. Survival is not consent.

connections.cybelia: could reroute a river or poison it; keeps her close

personas.future: God of the Wild. Will give his immortality to his apprentice, who dies in the first wave of devils.

personas.name: Witarr
personas.concept: A tiefling grave-cleric who keeps the dead down and the receipts in order
personas.class_note: Cleric (Grave Domain, 'Requiem Warden'), Lawful Neutral, ISTJ
personas.look: Medium height, lean, umber skin with an ash undertone, tight swept-back horns, blue-black hair, pale gold eyes, a tail belted at the waist, a rope scar at his throat. Travel blacks and grave greys, a bone-and-iron charm.
personas.voice: Dry, exact, documented. Tells demons his name.
personas.worldview: The world is held together by boundaries. Death is a law like gravity. The Brotherhood made magic contractual, which is exactly the shape devils like.

connections.nicana: trusts her because she treats boundaries as real
connections.girione: the first to talk to him without a lecture
